content: Cedax, available as capsules and oral suspension, contains the active ingredient cefditoren as cefditoren dihydrate. Cefditoren dihydrate is a semisynthetic cephalosporin antibiotic designed for oral administration. Chemically, it is identified as (+)-(6R,7R)-7-[2-(2-amino-4-thiazolyl)-2-methoxyiminoacetamido]-3-[(Z)-2-(4-methylthiazol-5-yl)ethenyl]-8-oxo-5-thia-1-azabicyclo[4.2.0]oct-2-ene-2-carboxylic acid, dihydrate. Its molecular formula is C15H14N4O6S2·2H2O. Cedax capsules contain cefditoren dihydrate equivalent to 400 mg of cefditoren. The inactive ingredients in the capsule formulation include magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, and sodium starch glycolate. The capsule shell and/or band are composed of gelatin, sodium lauryl sulfate, titanium dioxide, and polysorbate 80. Additionally, the capsule shell may contain benzyl alcohol, sodium propionate, edetate calcium disodium, butylparaben, propylparaben, and methylparaben. Cedax oral suspension, after reconstitution, contains cefditoren dihydrate equivalent to 90 mg of cefditoren per 5 mL. The suspension is cherry-flavored and includes the following inactive ingredients: cherry flavoring, polysorbate 80, silicon dioxide, simethicone, sodium benzoate, sucrose (approximately 1 g/5 mL), titanium dioxide, and xanthan gum.
